triage.rationale: Ecgberht steward campaign orchestration. Heavy: top-frontier seats on every role, cross-family. Durability via hardening-gate 0080/0081 (per-INSTANCE obligations map S1-S14) + delta-coverage 0091/0092. Anti-stub verdicts required at G4, exec2, conformance, T-HOST-0.

integrity.rule: sha256(IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md) MUST equal source_sha256 in wave-decomposition.json. Mismatch = STOP, do not build.

execution_order_note: DAG governs, NOT wave numbers: 1..18, then 20 -> 21 -> 22, then 19.
project_root_note: The DELIVERABLE IS THE SKILL (C:/dev/Ecgberht). Anchor is the REFERENCE HOST and implements host contracts only (executor, outbox producer, authorizer, routes/UI). NO steward logic in Anchor Python (NS v5 non-goal, CI-fenced in Wave 1). Plan/handoff dir lives in the Anchor repo; the BUILD runs from the Ecgberht root.
seating_note: Heavy = top-frontier models on EVERY seat, always cross-family. Set the transport driver and model env EXPLICITLY for this host before any wave (Explicit Driver Initialization Rule) and verify with ONE tiny call before the long run - a silent auth failure looks like flaky JSON.

test_lanes.skill: node C:/dev/Ecgberht/scripts/run-all-tests.mjs --lane skill  (HOST-LESS: no Anchor, no ANCHOR_TOKEN, no auth preflight)
test_lanes.auth_on: default run - Anchor integration; Wave-1 bootstrap MINTS an ephemeral ANCHOR_TOKEN and sets the auth pillar to enforce, asserting BOTH before any test counts
test_lanes.note: paths.auth_ok() returns True when ANCHOR_TOKEN is unset - an auth-ON assertion MUST first assert a token is configured and the mode is enforce, else it is vacuous.

pytest_bridge: run-all-tests.mjs (extended in Wave 1) invokes `python -m pytest <wave test paths>` with cwd C:/dev/Anchor for Anchor-side waves and folds the result into one pass/fail
real_run_note: CHEAP COMMISSION PROFILE only (LITE researchPrime, smallest depth). Real-run gates are wave-local scripts gate/<wave>-real-run.mjs (Wave 22: gate/t-host-0.mjs), EXCLUDED from the standing suite.
halt_conditions: conformance drift between the two executors
any DEGRADED path that would green a kill gate
hardening_law: crucible journal 0080/0081 - property gates emitted per INSTANCE (obligations map S1-S14), not per property class
delta_coverage_law: foreman journal 0091/0092 - surface changes need tests that name them (test/wNN-*.test.mjs)
